history.summary: Identity provisional: a small 'Shiv Mandir' on National Highway 229 in Daporijo is confirmed by a map/places listing (Instagram location: NH 229, Daporijo, coords 27.987709, 94.222064) and a yappe.in business listing (rating 3.0 from 2 reviews; address NH 229, Daporijo 791122). CSV error: the CSV state column holds the town name; correct state is Arunachal Pradesh. Founding date, builder, and history are unverified; this is a modern roadside town mandir, not an ancient site. Distinguish from the well-documented Meghna/Menga Cave Temple (natural limestone cave shrine of Shiva near Daporijo) — a separate, better-known site. Coordinates are POI-level from the map listing. Opening hours unverified.

name: Shiva Mandir
town_description: Daporijo is the headquarters of Upper Subansiri district, on the banks of the Subansiri river — the largest tributary of the Brahmaputra. The area's best-known religious site is the Meghna cave temple of Shiva nearby; the town itself is a remote district hub reached by long mountain roads.

travel.airport: Daporijo has an advance landing ground; nearest commercial airport is Donyi Polo Airport, Itanagar (Hollongi) — long mountain road journey (verify locally)
travel.railway: No railway in the district; nearest railheads in Assam (verify locally)
travel.road: NH 229 connects Daporijo toward Ziro/Itanagar; mountain roads, allow full days from the plains
